description:
To the payload corresponding JSON schema file is `Errors.json`, an array of error items, included in the JSON API `errors` member. 
Each error item must be conform to RFC 7807. It may contain additional information such as: 
- a JSON API `links` member, pointing to absolute/ relative URL with error details  
- a vendor specific information

title.description: Error title or HTTP status phrase.

status.description: HTTP status code as string, defined by JSON API.

links.description: Absolute URL reference to a detailed description of the error.
